rules.title: San Diego ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices using nonpublic competitor data (Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing Ordinance)
rules.requirement: San Diego landlords may not use software that analyzes nonpublic competitor data to set rents or occupancy levels, and no one may sell or license such software to landlords. Tenants can sue for an injunction, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 civil penalty per violation; each month and each property counts as a separate violation
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential rental property in the City of San Diego (as defined in SDMC § 98.0702). Applies to landlords who use algorithmic devices and to anyone who sells, licenses or provides them to landlords.
rules.exemptions: Software that publishes reports from aggregated nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old, or from public information, and does not recommend rents or occupancy levels for future leases or renewals; software used to set rents or income limits under local, state or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and each property a separate violation; costs and reasonable attorney's fees to a prevailing tenant; remedies are cumulative; SDMC Ch. 1, Art. 2 enforcement also applies.
rules.conflict_note: The official document in the record is the staff report and draft ordinance (O-2025-107), which takes effect 30 days after final passage but has no passage date. The in-force status and the June 2025 effective date come only from secondary sources. Verify adoption against the City Clerk record.
rules.reason: The draft ordinance text, the December 2024 news report of the draft, and two law-firm summaries of the enacted SDMC §§ 98.1101–98.1104 all describe the same ordinance, which secondary sources report as in force, so they are merged into one record that cites the official draft text.
